title: seeking 2d artists for team (we have judge pass!)
content: hello, i am seeking more artists for my team! honestly any would help lol. premise: you're the pilot of a planetary exploration mission and unexpectedly crash land when descending into the atmosphere of the planet. you black out after a loose piece of lab equipment hits you, then you wake up to another member of your crew shaking you awake. you and this crew member, an astrobiologist, explore the planet--until you both encounter another copy of the astrobiologist.
